titulo: Clear Answers to Your Therapy Questions
subtitulo: Everything you need to know about session duration, appointment formats, therapeutic approaches, and getting started.
side_desc: Message us on WhatsApp or call our clinic directly to coordinate your appointment in Miraflores, Villa El Salvador, or Live Online.
ws_msg: Hello Lic. Sofía, I have a question regarding psychological sessions

faqs.pregunta: How long does each therapy session last?
faqs.respuesta: The initial assessment consultation lasts a full 60 minutes to thoroughly review your background and provide immediate guidance. Regular ongoing sessions last 45 minutes.

faqs.pregunta: Which clinical approaches do you use?
faqs.respuesta: We utilize exclusively evidence-based therapeutic models: Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), Contextual Therapy (ACT), Systemic Psychotherapy for couples and families, and Humanistic Psychotherapy.

faqs.pregunta: How does ADHD & ASD diagnostic screening work?
faqs.respuesta: It is a comprehensive assessment package (S/ 600.00) including clinical interviews, standardized psychometric batteries, behavioral observation, and a formal signed report by a Licensed Psychologist.

faqs.pregunta: Where are your physical offices located?
faqs.respuesta: We operate from two locations: Miraflores Office (Av. Alfredo Benavides 620, Zafiro Building, Suite 403) on Saturdays, and South Lima Office (Av. 3 de Octubre Ruta B, Villa El Salvador) Monday to Friday. We also provide secure online sessions.

faqs.pregunta: What are the benefits of the 10-Session Package?
faqs.respuesta: The 10-session package costs S/ 600.00, providing more than 30% savings over individual sessions. It includes the 1-hour initial intake, 9 regular sessions, and ongoing takeaways between meetings.
We accept Yape, Plin digital wallets, direct bank transfers (BCP, BBVA), and Cash at the clinic.
